bio.text: Darline Graham was appointed as a Republican to the U.S. Senate from South Carolina on July 13, 2026, to fill the vacancy caused by the death of Lindsey O. Graham, and took the oath of office on July 14, 2026.
Graham was born in Central, Pickens County, South Carolina, and is a vocational rehabilitation counselor who served as a commissioner of the South Carolina Commission for the Blind.
Graham holds a B.S. in sociology from the College of Charleston (1989) and an M.A. in rehabilitation counseling from South Carolina State University (2009).
